  Maa kehti thi kya kya malaal jhele honge

  Jhula to nazar aayega...

  Jhula to nazar aayega...

  Mil jayega jab pani asghar na milega
  Jhula to nazar aayega...
  Bin pani ke dunya se sidhara mera asghar
  Jab aayega pani to meri pyari si dukhtar
  Dhoondegi use ban meiṅ asghar na milega
  Jhula to nazar aayega...

from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/asghar-na-milega.md')
metadata, rest = p.read_bytes().split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
old, body = rest.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
roman = old.decode()
for a,b in [
('julaane ko taras jayengi baaheiṅ','jhulaane so taras jaayeṅge baaheṅ'),
('dhoondegi nigaheiṅ','dhundeṅ gi nigaaheṅ'),
('shauq e shahadat','shauq-e-shahadat'),
('fatema sughra','Fatima Sughra'),
('guzregi','guzre gi'), ('kya bit','kya bit'),
]:
    assert a in roman or a == 'kya bit'
    roman = roman.replace(a,b)
pairs = dict(pair.split('/') for pair in '''
Maa/Maaṅ maa/maaṅ nahi/nahiṅ Qaime/Khaime aankheiṅ/aankheṅ
jayengi/jaayeṅgi jaungi/jaaungi aaja/aa\\u00a0ja
Dhayenge/Dhaayeṅge layiṅ/laeeṅ baysheer/beshir Shohada/Shuhada
Dhoondenge/Dhundeṅge dhoondengi/dhundeṅ\\u00a0gi Dhoondegi/Dhunde\\u00a0gi
reha/riha godh/god bahot/bahut royegi/roye\\u00a0gi muztar/Muztar
pani/paani kooza/kuza Ek/Ak aayenge/aayeṅge wo/woh
dunya/duniya irfan/Irfan mazhar/Mazhar asghar/Asghar sheh/shah
'''.replace('\\u00a0','~').split())
roman = re.sub(r'\\b\\w+\\b', lambda m: pairs.get(m[0], m[0]).replace('~',' '), roman)
source = body.decode().strip().splitlines()
lines = roman.splitlines()
assert len(source) == len(lines)
assert source[0] == '۱' and lines[0] == '  1'
assert all(s.endswith('۔۔۔') == r.endswith('...') for s,r in zip(source, lines))
assert all(c.isascii() or c in 'ṅṄ' for c in roman)
p.write_bytes(metadata + b'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + roman.encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + body)
print(f'Checked {len(lines)-1} verse lines.')
